newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.12 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.12 pct higher.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed up by 0.12 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The all-share index closed at 459.41 points, up from 458.79 on Monday.
Total volume was one million dinars against three million dinars over the previous session.
UBCI bank won 1.24 dinar to 42.86 dinars with the exchange of 5,260 shares.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was up 0.43 dinar to 15.02 with 10,233 shares changing hands.
Banque de l'Habitat rose 0.42 dinar to 14.52 dinars.
Milk firm Tunisie Lait eased 0.36 dinar to 22 dinars.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie edged lower 0.2 dinar to 29 dinars.
